title: Session TranscodingInfo, with real encode speed
description: Fill TranscodingInfo in sessions as Jellyfin 12.4 does (play method, codecs, container, bitrate, IsVideoDirect, IsAudioDirect, Framerate, CompletionPercentage, TranscodeReasons), so jellyfin-web's admin dashboard and the player's Playback info panel show what a transcode is doing; and improve on Jellyfin by showing the job's real encode speed against real time and which worker runs it.
acceptanceCriteria: Observed on a real Jellyfin 12.4 first: GET /Sessions and the player's Playback info during a re-encode, a copy and a direct play; capture in compat/captures
GET /Sessions carries TranscodingInfo for each transcoding session with the fields jellyfin-web reads, from any api replica
TranscodeReasons match the decision's reasons for the same PlaybackInfo
The dashboard's session card shows the transcode details and the Playback info panel shows codecs and direct flags, checked in jellyfin-web in the e2e tier
An improvement on Jellyfin, recorded in the differential allowlist: the encode speed (film seconds per wall second) is visible to the operator, and a job below 1x is flagged
source: post-task review after JS-019, 2026-11-07; jellyfin-web reads TranscodingInfo in its dashboard and player stats
notes: jellyscale sends no TranscodingInfo today, so both views are empty for a transcode. The metrics slice made the speed known per job; this puts it where operators and viewers already look.
